headline_result.gap_found: approximate_size_bytes (this campaign's canonical memory-size metric, referenced across 21 files) silently omitted every Phase 6D ordinal-facet structure
headline_result.fix: extracted accounting into ordinal_facet_bytes() helper, folded into approximate_size_bytes, exposed standalone via approximate_ordinal_facet_bytes()
headline_result.correctness_gate: new unit test: nonzero once brand/category/product_type indexed; never exceeds whole-index total; does not shrink as more data indexed -- 18/18 physical_index.rs tests pass
headline_result.measured_result: 2,876,248 bytes for the ordinal-facet structures on the real WANDS catalog (42,994 products), 26.2% of the whole index's 10,984,302 measured bytes, 66.90 bytes/product
headline_result.vs_prior_estimate: ~16.7x the earlier ~172 KB unmeasured analytical estimate
headline_result.named_limitation: still a flat byte-size approximation (String lengths, Vec/HashMap element sizes), not a dedicated RSS/allocator-level benchmark matching Phase 7's own methodology; measured only at WANDS' natural 1x scale, not across the Phase 6B scale ladder
